p0001-01.action: Move the eval and corpus subcommands to a shared tools/research crate, or gate them behind a non-default feature, and keep run/mcp/render/snapshot/merge/commands in the shipped CLI.

p0001-02.action: Extract one synchronous dispatch function over (AppHandle, action, params, caller_label) and call it from both the Tauri command and the QA control plugin. That drops roughly 60 duplicated lines.

p0001-03.action: Add an AppState::host() -> Result<DesktopHandle, String> helper and route the preferences.patch action through the shared lc_preferences body.

p0001-04.action: Define one `fn valid_path_str(s: &str) -> bool` (or a `checked_path` returning Result) in services.rs and reuse it from services.rs and native.rs.

p0001-05.action: Collapse each picker pair to the async variant, or one shared builder, and drop the unreferenced aliases from run, is_import_picker and is_picker_action.

p0001-06.action: Delete the three diagnose_* probes and keep the existing failure-layout.json, failure-dom.json and failure-native.png capture.

p0001-07.action: Factor `parse_connect(args, &mut i)` and `open_headless(library, demo, imports)` helpers and call them from both subcommands.

p0001-08.action: Add `clampPreviewEdge`/`clampMemoryMb` helpers and a `runAndRefresh(id, params)` helper.

findingMessages.p0001-01: The shipped lightcraft-cli (packaged by release.yml and the FreeBSD package script) links about 5,500 lines of research harnesses (cull_eval 1550, personal_auto_eval 1525, decision_manifest/extract/plane, denoise_eval, measure_batch, cull_timing). Their own usage text calls them experimental and they take NEW_* private corpus paths. Every user build compiles and ships them, and their rayon/geom/color/raw deps exist only for them.
findingMessages.p0001-02: control_dispatch's lc_native arm re-implements the whole lc_native action ladder (openLibrary, backup/restore, preferences.patch, saveBeforeClose, window actions, model folders, import pickers) a second time for QA control. The two copies already differ (QA saveBeforeClose has no caller-label handling), so a fix to one silently misses the other.
findingMessages.p0001-03: Every Tauri command opens with the same host/startup_error clones and the same `host.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| error.unwrap_or_else(|| "desktop host is unavailable"...))` expression, repeated about 10 times in this file. The lc_preferences body and the `preferences.patch` branch of lc_native are near-identical copies, so a change to GPU-recovery handling must be made twice.
findingMessages.p0001-04: The path-sanity predicate `path.is_empty() || path.len() > 8_192 || path.contains('\0')` is pasted at 8 sites with 8 differing error strings, plus a MAX_PERSISTED_LIBRARY_PATH constant that duplicates the same 8_192. Changing the limit needs 9 edits.
findingMessages.p0001-05: services.rs keeps a sync picker path (pick_files, pick_files_with_params, run's dialog arms) and a duplicate async path (pick_files_async, pick_files_with_params_async, run_import_picker) with identical extension filtering and limit checks. Many action aliases (pickPhotos, importFolder, pickDevice, importDevice, importLightroom, saveExport, exportFile, import) have no caller in web/src, native.rs or the engine. Only the path-only contract test touches some of them.
findingMessages.p0001-06: diagnose_native_viewport_bounce, diagnose_stage_child_invalidation and diagnose_same_parent_layout (about 340 lines of ad-hoc DOM probe scripts) run only on macOS inside the failure path of with_control. They are leftovers from chasing one layout-bounce bug. They never assert anything and only write evidence on an already-failed run.
findingMessages.p0001-07: mcp() and run() each hand-parse `--connect [ADDR]` (identical port/addr heuristic), `--demo`, `--library`, and the same Headless-open sequence (open_library, library_error, library_warnings, import paths). snapshot() repeats the Session builder chain a third time. A fix such as the #1178 connect heuristic has to be applied to each copy.
findingMessages.p0001-08: The previewEdge clamp `Math.max(512, Math.min(16384, Math.round(x)))` and the memoryMb clamp `Math.max(0, Math.min(1_048_576, ...))` are each written out 3 to 4 times across migrateLegacyUi, clampUi and preferenceUi. In `run`, the `await runCommand(...); await refresh(); return value;` tail repeats about 12 times.
